items.source: Defines the consistency levels for Weaviate operations.
items.translation: 定义 Weaviate 操作的持久化级别。

items.source: Write must receive an acknowledgement from all replica nodes.
items.translation: write 必须从所有副本节点收到确认。

items.source: Write must receive an acknowledgement from at least one replica node.
items.translation: 写入操作必须至少收到一个副本节点的确认。

items.source: Write must receive an acknowledgement from at least QUORUM replica nodes.
items.translation: 必须从至少 QUORUM 数量的副本节点收到确认。

items.source: Returns the enum constant of this class with the specified name.
items.translation: 返回此类的具有指定名称的枚举常量。

items.source:
Write must receive an acknowledgement from at least one replica node. This is
the fastest (most available), but least consistent option.
items.translation: 必须至少收到一个副本节点的确认。这是速度最快（可用性最高），但一致性最低的选择。

items.source:
Write must receive an acknowledgement from at least QUORUM replica nodes.
QUORUM is calculated as n / 2 + 1, where n is the number of replicas.
items.translation:
必须从至少 QUORUM 个副本节点收到确认。
QUORUM 的计算方式为 n / 2 + 1，其中 n 为副本数量。

items.source:
Write must receive an acknowledgement from all replica nodes. This is the most
consistent, but 'slowest'.
items.translation: write 必须从所有副本节点收到确认。这是最一致但也是最慢的方式。

items.source: • Weaviate Consistency Strategies
items.translation: • Weaviate 一致性策略
